temp_range.question: What is the full temperature range over the decade?
temp_range.reference:
readings = [t for _, t in temps]
temp_range = max(readings) - min(readings)

coverage.question: What fraction of the 365 days in 1982 does the longest run of days below 10 degrees cover?

hot_run_days.question: How many days have a temperature more than 2 standard deviations from the mean?
hot_run_days.reference:
import statistics
readings = [t for _, t in temps]
mean = statistics.mean(readings)
spread = statistics.stdev(readings)
hot_run_days = sum(1 for t in readings if abs((t - mean) / spread) > 2)

hot_share.question: What share of days have a temperature more than 2 standard deviations from the mean?
hot_share.reference:
import statistics
readings = [t for _, t in temps]
mean = statistics.mean(readings)
spread = statistics.stdev(readings)
outliers = sum(1 for t in readings if abs((t - mean) / spread) > 2)
hot_share = outliers / len(readings)
